[SWS_ComM_00982]
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09243
⌈For exchanging PNC status information between ComM and Nm, bit vectors shall be
used. Such a bit vector is called "PNC bit vector" and contain a maximum of 504 bits.⌋
Comment: The PNC bit vector is provided as a reference to an array of type uint8 to
the ComM within the dedicated APIs. Each bit in the PNC bit vector represents the
status of a particular PNC. The bit is called "PNC bit".
